description: A finite conjunction is true under a valuation exactly when every formula in its list is true.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval_finiteConj.{u} {α : Type u}
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (l : List (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.finiteConj l) = true ↔
    ∀ A ∈ l, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v A = true
